name: ModelAI comparator controls

GenericTemporal27.selection_rule: Select the 9 dynamic variables with highest non-missing observation density among training-partition patient-hours only; no labels used.
GenericTemporal27.window_rows: current hour plus previous five hourly rows within the same patient

missing_rules.two_or_more_observations: mean/range over finite observed values; OLS slope against actual hourly indices

GenericTemporal27.feature_ordering: [mean, range, slope] for each variable in ordered_variables, giving G01-G27

Noise27.generation: single frozen matrix in canonical full-cohort row order, then subset by the identical patient split

package_note: Comparator semantics unchanged; version increment reflects corrected end-to-end portable archive integration.
